source: R08 recovered product history + durable authority scans
purpose: Preserve the strongest low-maintenance Prometeo Alimentación product rules without requiring old chats or publishing personal data.
core_loop: keep a simple buying checklist adjacent

interaction.selection_feedback: immediate tactile/visual feedback only on real state change
interaction.random_choice_control: allowed as a quick alternative to deliberate selection
interaction.shopping: local toggle checklist, not pantry truth

visual.depth_rule: depth belongs to manipulable pieces; passive page/card surfaces stay flat
visual.bars: compact horizontal indicators that never crowd out the chooser
responsive_failures: nutrient bars becoming the largest visual object

data.persistence: localStorage is acceptable for non-sensitive UI/checklist state in the reconstruction; future canonical ownership requires a separate authority decision
data.nutrition_semantics: comparative UI hints only; no medical or dietary prescription and no false precision

must_preserve: Value must be available without maintaining inventory.
The immediate decision surface is primary; buying is secondary.
One flexible primary selector plus accompaniments can represent the decision without duplicate meal-time forms.
Two-color visual grammar remains coherent across chooser, bars and shopping state.
The same interaction remains usable on phone touch and desktop pointer.
The reconstructed candidate must self-identify in source metadata as RECONSTRUCTED_CANDIDATE.
must_not: claim reconstructed bytes are historical bytes
publish personal food lists or history
add a persistent bottom tab bar
add rigid duplicate lunch/dinner selectors by default
use nutrition bars as medical scoring
allow mobile overlap or dead controls
acceptance_for_reconstruction: single-page HTML works without external libraries
primary selector responds to tap, drag and wheel
accompaniments toggle without opening a modal
random-choice control changes the primary choice
compact bars update when the visible meal composition changes
palette switch keeps exactly two active base colors
source contains no personalized food/history payload
source clearly labels authority as RECONSTRUCTED_CANDIDATE
